title: RealtimeSessionToken
description: The response from the realtime session token endpoint that creates the auth token to be used with the realtime speech service.

compartmentId.description: Compartment ID that was used to create the token.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer and boolean types are supported.

Key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`.

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"foo-namespace-1": {"bar-key-1": "value-1", "bar-key-2": "value-2"}, "foo-namespace-2": {"bar-key-1": "value-1", "bar-key-2": "value-2"}}`.

freeformTags.description:
Simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type or scope. Exists for cross-compatibility only.
Example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`.

sessionId.description: The session ID this token corresponds to. Provided for convenience, the session ID is already present in the JWT token.

token.description: The session token (JWT) to be consumed by the websocket server. The token contains the session/tenant ID, as well as the expiry time.
